summary: Discusses the applicability of the QUIC transport protocol, with a focus on caveats that affect application protocol development and deployment over QUIC. It is aimed at designers of application protocol mappings to QUIC and the implementers of those protocols. It is informational.

eli5.summary: If you are building something on QUIC, this is the advice sheet. It covers the surprises that can trip up people moving apps onto it.
